releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.37 — the reason messages stopped going, fixed at the root. Every send carried an id like "local-1", "local-2"… that restarted from one on each launch, and the server uses that id as its duplicate key: from the second session onwards every message matched an older message from the same account, so the server answered with that old row, stored nothing and delivered nothing. Ids are now real UUIDs (exactly what the web client generates), so every message is new and actually goes out — in 1:1 chats and in groups, whose duplicate key also includes the group id, which is why groups kept working longer. Pending messages can no longer be edited or deleted as if they had a server id, and a queue left over from an older build is discarded instead of replayed.
